products.name: Teakwood Noir
products.description: A dark, polished woody scent for long evenings. It opens with bergamot and black pepper, settles into a heart of teakwood and cardamom, and dries down to vetiver and amber. An eau de parfum with 20%+ fragrance oil, it lasts 8–10 hours on skin.
products.short_description: A dark, polished woody scent for long evenings.

products.name: Cedar Ember
products.description: Warm cedar with a glowing, smoky edge. It opens with grapefruit and pink pepper, settles into a heart of cedarwood and clary sage, and dries down to tonka bean and smoked woods. An eau de parfum with 20%+ fragrance oil, it lasts 8–10 hours on skin.
products.short_description: Warm cedar with a glowing, smoky edge.
